"""Supplementary actual pre-change-binary saved-plan restart proof, disposable only."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, stat, subprocess, tempfile, time
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--legacy',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--app',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=pathlib.Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--managed-discovery-fixtures',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
legacy=a.legacy.resolve();app=a.app.resolve();gh=pathlib.Path(shutil.which('gh')).resolve()
auth=os.environ.get('GH_TOKEN') or os.environ.get('GITHUB_TOKEN') or subprocess.check_output([str(gh),'auth','token'],text=True).strip()
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def snapshot(root):
 rows=[]
 for path in [root,*sorted(root.rglob('*'))]:
  s=path.lstat();kind='link' if path.is_symlink() else 'directory' if path.is_dir() else 'file'
  data=os.readlink(path).encode() if kind=='link' else path.read_bytes() if kind=='file' else b''
  rows.append(dict(path=str(path.relative_to(root)),kind=kind,device=s.st_dev,inode=s.st_ino,mode=stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()))
 return rows
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='skillview-legacy-owner-proof-') as temporary:
 root=pathlib.Path(temporary).resolve();home=root/'home';home.mkdir()
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('CODEX_HOME', 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR', 'CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR', 'CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS', 'CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR') if not k.startswith(('GIT_','SKILLVIEW_'))}
 env.update(HOME=str(home),USERPROFILE=str(home),GH_TOKEN=auth,GH_EXTENSION='1',GH_PATH=str(gh),GH_CONFIG_DIR=str(root/'gh-config'),SKILLVIEW_STATE_HOME=str(root/'state'),XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(root/'config'),XDG_STATE_HOME=str(root/'xdg-state'),XDG_DATA_HOME=str(root/'data'),XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(root/'cache'),APPDATA=str(root/'appdata'),LOCALAPPDATA=str(root/'localappdata'),CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=str(home/'.claude'),PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=str(home/'.pi/agent'),GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='0',GH_TELEMETRY='false',GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER='1',GH_NO_EXTENSION_UPDATE_NOTIFIER='1')
 install=subprocess.run([str(gh),'skill','install','--agent','universal','--scope','user','--','cli/cli','skills/gh-skill'],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);assert install.returncode==0,install.stderr
 payload=home/'.agents/skills/gh-skill';registry=home/'.agents/.skill-lock.json'
 registry_object=json.loads(registry.read_bytes());selector='gh-skill';registry_object['skills'][selector]['updatedAt']='2020-01-01T00:00:00Z';registry.write_text(json.dumps(registry_object,indent=2)+'\n')
 (payload/'schema1-local-extra.txt').write_bytes(b'local extra retained across old schema1 recovery\n')
 original=snapshot(payload);owner=registry.read_bytes()
 def args(host,command,*arguments):return [str(host),command,*map(str,arguments),'--allow-hidden-dirs','--json']
 def run(host,command,*arguments):
  r=subprocess.run(args(host,command,*arguments),cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
  assert r.returncode==0,(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
  return json.loads(r.stdout)
 plan=run(legacy,'restore-plan','--path',payload)['operation'];assert plan.get('revision') is None,plan
 plan_sha=sha(pathlib.Path(plan['planPath']))
 if a.managed_discovery_fixtures:
  builtin=home/'.codex/skills/.system/builtin-fixture';builtin.mkdir(parents=True);(builtin/'SKILL.md').write_bytes(b'---\nname: builtin-fixture\ndescription: Compatibility fixture\n---\nBody\n')
  plugin=home/'.codex/plugins/cache/fixture-market/fixture-plugin/1.0.0';meta=plugin/'.codex-plugin';meta.mkdir(parents=True);(meta/'plugin.json').write_text('{"name":"fixture-plugin"}')
  packaged=plugin/'skills/packaged-fixture';packaged.mkdir(parents=True);(packaged/'SKILL.md').write_bytes(b'---\nname: packaged-fixture\ndescription: Compatibility fixture\n---\nBody\n')
  observed=run(app,'list');managed=[item for item in observed['skills'] if item['name'] in ('builtin-fixture','packaged-fixture')]
  assert len(managed)==2 and all(any(owner['readOnly'] for owner in item['ownerRecords']) for item in managed),observed
 inspected=run(app,'restore-inspect','--id',plan['id'])['operation'];assert inspected['status']=='ready',inspected
 worker=subprocess.Popen(args(legacy,'restore-apply','--id',plan['id'],'--yes','--disposition','retain-original','--expect',plan['planFingerprint']),cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 try:
  end=time.monotonic()+90;killed=False
  while time.monotonic()<end and worker.poll() is None:
   if pathlib.Path(plan['retainedPath']).exists():worker.kill();killed=True;break
   time.sleep(.002)
  out,err=worker.communicate(timeout=60);assert killed and worker.returncode!=0,(out,err)
 finally:
  if worker.poll() is None:worker.kill();worker.communicate(timeout=60)
 interrupted=run(app,'restore-inspect','--id',plan['id'])['operation'];assert interrupted['status'] in ('original-retained','installed'),interrupted
 recovered=run(app,'restore-recover','--id',plan['id'],'--yes','--expect',interrupted['reviewFingerprint'])['operation'];assert recovered['succeeded'] and recovered['status']=='installed',recovered
 reviewed=run(app,'restore-inspect','--id',plan['id'])['operation'];undone=run(app,'restore-undo','--id',plan['id'],'--yes','--expect',reviewed['reviewFingerprint'])['operation'];assert undone['succeeded'] and undone['status']=='restored',undone
 assert snapshot(payload)==original and registry.read_bytes()==owner
 result=dict(newManagedRootsObservedAfterSavingPlan=a.managed_discovery_fixtures,legacyHostSha256=sha(legacy),nativeHostSha256=sha(app),gh=subprocess.check_output([str(gh),'--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],savedPlanSha256=plan_sha,schemaVersion=1,recordedRestoration=True,persistedLegacyPlanInspected=True,actualLegacyApplyKilled=True,interruptedStatus=interrupted['status'],forwardRecoveryVerified=True,undoPreservedOriginalNativeObjectsBytesModes=True,exactOriginalRegistryBytesRestored=True)
 a.output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

Previously missed (1) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Report retained payload path when update-plan is already current `src/​SkillView.Core/​Cli/​CliDispatcher.Restore.cs:79` When `update-plan --path ... --json` finds an already-current installation, this branch writes the generic payload impact, reporting `payloadRetained: false` and a null retained path even though the original remains installed. Text output also omits the retained location. Set retention-aware evidence before either renderer, using `current.Path`, and add a regression asserting the no-op impact.
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

### 🔵 Needs a closer look Cross-platform native identity and saved-plan compatibility still require final verification and human review. **0 open findings**
Previously missed (3) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Backup impact falsely claims payload retention for dangling links `src/​SkillView.Core/​Cli/​CliDispatcher.cs:698` `backup --path` can select a scanner-produced dangling-link row. Capture then fails because there is no payload directory, but the catch emits this impact with `payloadRetained: true`, contradicting its `broken-link` subject. Only claim retention when the frozen subject observed a directory, and include that observed location rather than leaving successful backups' retained location unknown. Cover the dangling-link failure in a regression test.
Incorrect retention reported for dangling-link update selections `src/​SkillView.Core/​Maintenance/​SavedUpdateCoordinator.cs:192` A dangling-link inventory row is selectable with `update --path` or `update --all`. Its `untracked` outcome, or an incomplete-inventory refusal, reaches this initializer and reports a retained payload at the broken link's address even though the frozen subject says `broken-link`. Derive retention from the frozen subject's materialization and leave the retained path null when no directory payload was observed. Add a regression for these outcomes.
Removal reports lose duplicate-path skip count on cancellation or failure `src/​SkillView.Core/​Ui/​CleanupScreen.cs:386` If removal is canceled after duplicate paths were filtered out, this rebuilds `LastReport` with `TargetsSkipped = 0`, losing the count already published through `RemovalAttemptState`. The failure branch has the same problem. Keep an attempt state even when the caller omits it, and copy its pre-validation skip count into both synthetic reports. Extend `RemoveSelectedAsync_CancellationPublishesDuplicateSkipCount` to assert that `LastReport.TargetsSkipped` retains its one known skip.
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

### 🔵 Needs a closer look Cross-platform native identity and saved-state compatibility still require final verification and human review, alongside correction of the retained reporting defect. **0 open findings**
Previously missed (1) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Undo failures retain quarantine operation instead of undo `src/​SkillView.Core/​Cli/​CliDispatcher.cs:560` If `undo` throws after reading `prepared.json`, this callback has saved an impact labeled `quarantine`. The exception skips the command rewrite at lines 586–587, and the catch block writes that unchanged impact, so refusal or cancellation JSON identifies the wrong operation. Stamp the requested command in this callback so failure output reports `impact.operation: "undo"` while preserving the recorded subject.
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced
